description: Manage Stamped reviews, questions and review requests, read NPS responses, and manage loyalty customers, points and VIP tiers, with triggers for new reviews, questions, customers and loyalty activity.

stamped_new_customer_trigger.description: Runs when a customer is added to Stamped (Loyalty 2.0 stores).

output.customer: The record returned by the service

stamped_new_loyalty_activity_trigger.description: Runs when a customer earns, spends or is given loyalty points (Loyalty 2.0 stores).

output.activity: The record returned by the service

stamped_new_nps_response_trigger.description: Runs when a customer answers your Net Promoter Score survey.

output.npsResponse: The record returned by the service

stamped_new_question_trigger.description: Runs when a customer asks a question about a product.

output.question: The record returned by the service

stamped_new_review_trigger.description: Runs when a customer leaves a review.

output.review: The record returned by the service

stamped_new_reward_trigger.description: Runs when a customer redeems a loyalty reward (Loyalty 2.0 stores).

output.reward: The record returned by the service
